items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But you knew Ray before he went with Duke, didn't you? Or did you know of him? [INTERVIEWEE] I knew him, yeah.

ctx.x: Let me put it in a time context. Ray, he was -- maybe like a layoff. Duke was -- the band was kind of quiet at that point, and Ray just came home, you know?
